name: five-hits-bounds
description: Five Fireballs at one spawned monster, then min/max/sum bounds on what it took: the repetition shape, and how a run reports a formula that drifts out of its expected band.

steps.note: a rare at level 10 survives five hits; its label is 'Rhoa Mare@10' whatever rarity or custom name is given
start the ledger from an empty one
the fifth hit lands after this
five hits, each with a real roll; narrow raw_min/raw_max to the band the formula predicts (raw is the resolved damage; taken is clamped at the monster's remaining life)
the total to compare with the formula; raise this to the expected sum before the run
